was the seventh line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between and , and had a total of 18 stations. It was established alongside Edward Sphere Station on August 7 2013. Moreover, a branch between and was set up on this branch, which commenced services on August 15 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description

was the seventh District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from southeast Terracept Continent to north Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by the Pink Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 6.

At the time of its closure, this route was 27.3 km long, with a total of 18 stations.

Fun Facts

  • This line is a triangular line with three termini, meaning that trains between the Branch, the branch and the south terminus at can travel to and from each other. This makes the only line in Nazca Railway history to have such a layout.While Los Sengas Division also had lines that have three termini, such as and , trains can't travel directly between the branches for both lines (For instance, trains from can't go directly to , and passengers have to travel to first if they want to go to from ), whereas trains can travel between at the branch and at the branch without having to change at .</ref>
  • This line is named after the United States of EtErNalGLX, one of the four former kingdoms of Terracept.

Fun Facts

  • While Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint was meant to be one single large checkpoint, it was split into two different checkpoints due to schanges in plans, with the second checkpoint being this station. In total, the two Checkpoints serve seven lines.
  • This Station is the first station to feature two different Los Sengas Coffees.While Metropolis Terminal in also featured two different restaurants at the time of this station's construction, The restaurant at Phase 3 is not considered a Los Sengas Coffee.</ref>
  • This Station is home to a former Construction Team named Jupituropa, and as the name of that team alludes to Jupiter, the name of this station also alludes to Europa, one of the moons of Jupiter.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsKMpjjYMFI&t=1633s</ref>
  • This Station is the first Checkpoint to feature NR Shops. However, the NR Shops did not begin operations until after the extension of to this station.
  • The construction of this station began mid-January of 2019, but was not completed until February 2 that same year. The construction works took more than ten days.
  • The percentage of Sandstone on the Platform Walls increase with the platform depth as it is believed that shallower depths mean lower degrees of darkness.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XsKMpjjYMFI&t=1962s</ref>
  • This Station is the first station in Los Sengas Division besides of Metropolis Terminal have two-digit platforms.
  • This Station is the first Checkpoint in Nazca Railway to '''NOT''' feature any lines from Season 1.
  • The Transfer Passageways of This Station can form a complete loop across all concourses of this station from both inside and outside the gate areas.

History

The origins of can be traced back to the later stages of Peckern North Railway planning. A football embassador has suggested the construction of football stadiums in Peckern North, and putting into account traffic flow within Peckern North, two soccer stadiums are constructed on the other side of Tin Kam Pier and Tin Kam Bay.

However, original plans of railway development did not involve railway transport in that area, and they are situated a few kilometers away from the closest point on . Therefore, developers in Peckern North have decided to put the reserved railway extension to use, and reach what is now Grand Junction Station. Subsequent discussion with Nazca Railway has seen the establishment of this line.

safeHtml:
'''Exalt Gardens''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-08.

History

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Exalt Gardens. One of them has to do with paying homage to Kay Lee, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other was the fact that many billionaires spent money in this District to build a garden that appeared fancy but had also given rise to complaints about the gardens wasting public funds. Ultimately, the said garden, which was named "Exalt Gardens" was demolished due to public backlash.

Exalt Garden is one of the few Sub-Districts that did not undergo major changes from the planning stage, with its main development being the construction of Public Housing and a Major Wet Market. However, as the size of the Wet Market has been vastly overestimated, the unused land from its construction has become Housing Land Use in the form of Sheung Chi Estate and Yee Hin Court.

Despite being named "Exalt Gardens", the Police Station and the Library in this District have the prefix of "Brighton Hall".

Station Characteristics

  • This station is one of the Group 2 Gateways of Nazca Railway, and is located at approximately 20 km to the northwest of Metropolis Terminal.The other three stations in the same group are , and .</ref>

Fun Facts

  • While this station is located directly to the north of Havenore Station, as is projected to go northwest, and with this station using east-west oriented platforms, a Question-Mark bend is made before trains reach this station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=4942s</ref> A similar arrangement is also seen for between Comp Ward Station and Pan-ward Station.
  • This Station has set up a template for Group 2 Gateways with the regards that the colored glass is located to the sides of the tracks instead of at the platform gates.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=5030s</ref> Noticeably, another feature of Group 2 Gateways with the exception of Spring Point Gateway is the colored patterns of Concrete behind the Walls next to the stained glass. For Upper Level Platforms, the representative colored concrete is located beneath the Light Gray Concrete, and for Lower Level Platforms, the representative colored concrete is located above the Light Gray Concrete.
  • To allude to the Enclosed curse of , the concourse of this station is built directly above the Platforms.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BQ5qdspORn4&t=5165s</ref>
  • This Station is the last station in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) built before the expansion of West Shoal Checkpoint to have its own wiki page.

title: Field Joy
safeHtml:
'''Field Joy''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is the Southernmost Sub-District of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-12.

History

The name of this Sub-District originates from a Vocalist who has a psychedelic voice to heal wounded hearts. Her descendants were also inspired by this and made use of Singing Bowl Therapy to bring joy to citizens living in this district. This method of therapy has been reevaluated and saw this method of Therapy as an important part of Sound Therapy. This became the namesake of this Sub-District in order to praise the contributions of the singer to Sound Therapy.

Field Joy is also the Sub-District which has undergoen the most drastic changes due to Asylum replanned development. Original Plans had seen the Southwest of this District constructing a School Village three times the scale of that in Tin Wing, and as a result of this development, the vicinity of this area featured an abundance of L-shpaed turns and T-junctions. However, with the plans of Snowty development becoming clearer, the Developer of Asylum realized the importance of connectivity between the two districts, and had rebulit them into cross junctions, as well as scrapping the School Village Project and replacing it with Public Housing which later became Tsui Lam Estate, Po Lam Estate, King Lam Estate, Cheung Lam Estate and Kwong Lam Estate. After the replanning of Asylum, Field Joy became one of the Sub-Districts with high Public Housing Proportions at 65%, with its total population exceeding 190 thousand.

Snowty and Field Joy did not have any road access. As a result, Drivers had to make a detour to the north before going south, and pass through Pak Hoi Road to leave Asylum. Many Housing Estates were located at least a kilometer to the southwest of Route 3 Exit 17, with Kwong Lam Estate even being two kilometers to the south. This apparently caused transport issues that had plagued residents of the Field Joy area, and ironically made Field Joy one of the unhappiest areas in Asylum. However, this problem has since been mitigated with the development of the compound Snowty-Asylum Development Area.

It should also be noted that, prior to the rezoning of Asylum, Ming Lam Estate and Ivory Plaza, despite being located within Field Joy, were administered by the Fine Woods subdistrict, but after the rezoning, they are now both located in the Fine Woods subdistrict.

Future Development

The current developer of Asylum has collaborated with the developer of Snowty regarding Southwest Field Joy development. Housing Zones will expand to the west or southwest within Field Joy and will mainly focus on Public Hosuing. Public Housing will continue to end with the word "Lam" and Home Ownership Scheme Housing will continue to end with the word "Hei".

title: Fine Woods
safeHtml:
'''Fine Woods''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central East Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-14.

History

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Fine Woods. One of them has to do with Urban Legends that involved sightings of a woman who likes fine silk wandering in nearby woods by natives. Another possible source of this name is the fact that the developer of Asylum wished his friend who has started a Fan Club for a new Female Singer well.

While Fine Woods had also undergone considerations of renaming, plans to rename that district was ultimately scrapped due to fierce opposition. Subsequently, the Asylum Developer also made changes to plans in Fine Woods, such as increasing the proportion of Public Housing, and removing small parts of Administrative Facilities. However, the plan that involved the integration of a Market, a Leisure Center and a Sports Ground did not see any changes. When Home Ownership Scheme Housing is considered, this Sub-District has up to 80% Public Housing, and this District is also the most populated Sub-District in Asylum with a population of 280'000.
